description: Subdomains of a domain seen in certificate transparency logs: each name with the first and last certificate dates, the issuer of the newest certificate, and wildcard entries flagged. Deduplicated, newest first, up to 500. CertSpotter is read first, but its free index is partial, so those answers are marked truncated with the reason; crt.sh is the fallback and is complete. Only public certificates are listed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
